traits.name: Cooperative Hunting
traits.text: After the hunter attempts a Strike at a Large or larger target (regardless of success or failure), the next Strike one of the hunter's allies makes against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

traits.name: Fan Bolt
traits.text: The hunter prepares their hooked crossbow bolts with carefully woven seaweed. On a successful crossbow Strike, the bolt embeds and the seaweed fan deploys. The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its swim Speed. A creature can Interact to attempt a DC Athletics check, removing the bolt on a success.

traits.name: Hunt Prey
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate); The locathah hunter designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the prey and to Survival checks to Track the prey. The first time the locathah hits their designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 (1d8) precision damage. These effects last until the hunter uses Hunt Prey again.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.text: The hunter's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 (1d8) damage to creatures within reach of at least two of the hunter's allies.

traits.name: Smooth Swimmer
traits.text: The locathah hunter ignores difficult terrain caused by aquatic terrain features.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: crossbow (12 fan bolts), longspear, scale mail;

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ crossbow +10 (range increment 120 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d8 (1d8) piercing plus fan bolt
